issues.title: Truncated Relationship Diagram File
issues.why: The file 05-relationship-diagrams.md is truncated at the 136KB cap, leaving the 'Complete Schema Example' and 'AI Implementation Checklist' incomplete.
issues.fix: Move the 'Complete Schema Example' to a standalone file or ensure the overview's Canonical DDL is the primary reference.

issues.title: SQLite Concurrency Logic Externalized
issues.why: Critical concurrency handling (WAL, retries, busy_timeout) is referenced via AC-13/AC-22 but the actual implementation logic is in spec/13, which is not provided.
issues.fix: Inline the specific SQLite PRAGMA and retry settings into 02-schema-design.md §4.3.

issues.title: Boolean Type Ambiguity in SQLite
issues.why: Spec allows both INTEGER and BOOLEAN for SQLite, but notes BOOLEAN is an alias. This can confuse mediocre coders on which to use in DDL.
issues.fix: Strictly mandate 'INTEGER' for SQLite boolean columns in the Canonical DDL and §2.1.1.
